episode_summary: In this episode, Chris Linsell discusses the transformative impact of AI on the real estate industry, emphasizing the importance of relationship building and advisory roles for agents. The conversation also covers the future dynamics between Zillow, Compass, and indie brokerages, and highlights the critical role of social media in personal branding for agents.
